policy: Permissive only (M10 decision 1, founder 7 Oct 2026: go with the recommendations). Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-2/3-Clause, ISC, Zlib, BSL-1.0 and similar are allowed. MPL-2.0 only for the items named here; LGPL only as an unmodified, separately replaceable shared library named here, never linked statically; never GPL, AGPL, SSPL or non-commercial. One file read by the npm gate (license-check.mjs), the Python gate (python/tests/test_licences.py) and the native gate (native-licences.mjs, with native-libs.json). An entry whose `approved` is `pending` was found by the native gate in what the pack already ships and waits for the founder: CI passes with a warning, the release build (--strict) fails until it is approved or removed.

allowed.$comment: SPDX ids allowed in everything we ship. `spdx` applies to npm, Python and native code; `native` adds the permissive licences of C libraries (libpng, libtiff, SQLite's blessing and similar), checked by native-licences.mjs only.

mpl.name: certifi
mpl.use: Mozilla CA bundle in the pipeline pack (through rasterio), unmodified

mpl.name: eigen
mpl.use: Linear algebra headers compiled into COLMAP, Ceres and PDAL (G1), unmodified, EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY

lgplShared.name: geos
lgplShared.use: Shared library inside the shapely and rasterio wheels, unmodified and replaceable

lgplShared.name: libiconv
lgplShared.use: GNU libiconv as a shared library (iconv-2.dll) inside the rasterio Windows wheel, already in pipeline packs 0.2 and 0.3; unmodified and replaceable. Found by the G1 native gate.

lgplShared.name: libspatialite
lgplShared.use: SpatiaLite as a shared library (spatialite.dll) inside the rasterio Windows wheel, already in pipeline packs 0.2 and 0.3; unmodified and replaceable. Found by the G1 native gate.

lgplShared.name: freexl
lgplShared.use: FreeXL as a shared library (freexl-1.dll) inside the rasterio Windows wheel, already in pipeline packs 0.2 and 0.3; unmodified and replaceable. Found by the G1 native gate.

lgplShared.name: libquadmath
lgplShared.use: GCC quad-precision maths as a shared library (.dylibs/libquadmath) inside the numpy and scipy macOS wheels, already in pipeline packs 0.2 and 0.3; unmodified and replaceable. Found by the G1 native gate.

runtimes.$comment: Compiler runtimes that come with the wheels and CPython. Not open source licences in the allow-list, but runtimes their licences let any program ship.
runtimes.name: gcc-runtime
runtimes.use: libgfortran and libgcc_s as shared libraries in the numpy and scipy macOS wheels, and libgfortran linked into their OpenBLAS DLLs on Windows (scipy-openblas, GCC 10.3), already in pipeline packs 0.2 and 0.3. The GCC Runtime Library Exception lets the code compiled with them ship under any licence. Found by the G1 native gate.

runtimes.name: msvc-runtime
runtimes.use: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs (vcruntime140, msvcp140, vcomp140 and their siblings) that CPython and the Windows wheels ship, redistributable under the Visual Studio licence terms, unmodified. Already in pipeline packs 0.2 and 0.3.
